entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I received a few days ago. I'd like to return an item.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Of course. The name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order is VF-902105.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Aero Road Helmet. It looks like it was delivered four days ago. So I can best assist you, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. The helmet itself seems fine, but the color is a bit brighter in person than I was expecting. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.

I completely understand. Getting the color just right is important. Since it's not a technical issue and you're well within our 90-day return window for this item, I can absolutely approve a return for a full refund.

That's good to hear. Now, I am a VIP member and I have to go through the trouble of shipping this back. To make it worth my while, is there any chance you could offer me a small credit or a discount code to use on a future order?

That's a reasonable question, Sarah. We truly value your business as a VIP member. While our policy doesn't allow for credits on preference-based returns, as a gesture of our appreciation for your loyalty, I can add a 15% discount coupon directly to your account. You could use it to order that helmet in a different color if you'd like. How does that sound?
A 15% coupon would be perfect, actually. That's very helpful. Thank you for doing that.

You are very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment. I have just initiated the return and the pre-paid shipping label is on its way to your email. The 15% coupon is now active on your account as well. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. I appreciate your help, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
